source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity with three policy scripts; no baseline-restore step is present.

source_snapshot.procedure: For policies 00/01/02: write 0x00/0x06, read 0x00/0x01, cold-reset BMC, read again, then physically remove/reapply AC in on/off states; generic log clear.
source_snapshot.criteria: Policy bits 6:5 and AC return behavior match each policy.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; one policy per run plus physical operator.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Chassis status provides readback, not AC behavior.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 preserves real AC behavior; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Verify always-off, last-state and always-on policy persistence and actual AC-restoration behavior, with last-state tested from both on and off.
original_method: One policy per approved run using 0x00/0x06, decoded 0x00/0x01 before/after BMC reset, controlled physical AC cycle and baseline restore.
manual_activity: Owner approves one policy and initial power-state matrix; physical operator performs AC removal/reapply.
safety_requirements: No automatic power recovery or retry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial only; it omits source-required BMC-reset persistence and AC behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected one-policy writer/decoder with reconnect observer and human AC checkpoint.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All policies, commands and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Independently run each policy; decode bits before/after BMC reset, then verify exact AC-return matrix and restore original policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-policy approvals, safe AC operation and restore.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readback alone cannot prove AC restoration; last-state needs both initial states.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Can interrupt workloads and leave wrong boot behavior.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tool must preserve policy write, reset persistence and physical AC behavior.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master batches disruptive policies, reset and AC cycles, clears logs, lacks original-policy restore and uses unsafe tooling; DeepSeek drops required behavior coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Commands and criteria are explicit; safe environment/operator/approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates each policy and preserves actual AC behavior plus baseline restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical AC and power-state mutation require package, fresh confirmation and human operator; read-only substitution is insufficient.
